claims.nodeLabel: House Oversight hearing, 26 July 2023 - 'Unidentified Anomalous Phenomena: Implications on National Security, Public Safety, and Government Transparency'
claims.sourceText: docs.house.gov Committee Repository, EventID 116282, document list
claims.text: The House Committee Repository record for event 116282 (docs.house.gov/meetings/GO/GO06/20230726/116282) holds the notice, memo, member roster, attendance sheet, each witness's written statement, Truth in Testimony form and bio, the official transcript (HHRG-118-GO06-Transcript-20230726.pdf, posted 8 September 2023), and materials submitted for the record by Reps. Burchett and Luna, including the Defense Intelligence Reference Document 'Advanced Space Propulsion Based on Vacuum (Spacetime Metric) Engineering'.

He is on no congressional witness list. The committee-published witness lists for 26 July 2023 (event 116282), 13 November 2024 (event 117722) and 9 September 2025 name him nowhere, and the printed records of all three hearings contain his name exactly once in total, in the Burlison colloquy.

claims.locator: DIRD and Corbell report submitted for the record
claims.text: Submitted for the record of the 26 July 2023 hearing the Defense Intelligence Reference Document 'Advanced Space Propulsion Based on Vacuum (Spacetime Metric) Engineering', Jeremy Corbell's report 'The UAP Puzzle', and a statement for the record by George Knapp; all are filed under docs.house.gov event 116282.
